title: ep1.0_research_preview.md
variant: stick-figure dialogue reel v2 (full-episode pass) · fastrec takes over a temp bed
logline: Act Three for flow and dialogue: the fastrec takes laid to a stick shot plan from the script, one beat per shot or held setup. Stick figures and text cards stand in for the picture.

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · the home room, opened close
beats.caption: From behind the rack: desk, LEDs, monitor, glass; a faded sphere outline on the wall. The slot slides out a box.
cues: music: MM-01 Water Line (DARK ROOM), one performance across sc 18-22 · thins to one instrument under talk
sound: the dark room bed: rack fans, LEDs ticking in straight eighths, the cyan key's faint buzz
sfx: the rack's drive slot whirs and slides a box out like a tray (~1.8 s)

beats.caption: The box's label, legible as he reaches for the lid: who sent it, and to whom. His other company's device.
beats.real: JUL 24, 2023 · COINWORLD launches THE ORB [V] (co-founded by him; tagline [INVENTED] for its stated purpose, proof of personhood; label wording to the facts owner)

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · the Orb rises (three held steps)
beats.caption: He lifts the lid. A one-lens chrome sphere rises out of the foam to eye level. The lens finds him.

onscreen.text: THE ORB / IT'S SEEN THINGS. MOSTLY IRISES.

cues: sfx: a servo whirrs; the sphere rises in three held steps (0.3-1.5 s); the lens swivels, dilates

beats.caption: A thin cyan cone fans out from the lens across his face.
cues: STYLE · GLYPH-MASKED next: 5 frames, inside the scan cone only (GLYPH use 1 of 2)

beats.caption: Inside the cone his face is tokens: small monospace glyphs in the shape of a calm man.
cues: STYLE · GLYPH-MASKED (the stick reel dissolves the whole frame; the show masks only the cone)

beats.caption: By frame 6 the cone is gone. A toast pops beside the Orb.

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · the Orb drifts to his shoulder (held)
beats.caption: It settles exactly into the faded outline on the wallpaper. It fits. It has always fitted.

lines.text: i made it for everyone else.

cues: music: the Water Line thins to one felt note under the V.O.
sfx: CHIME ~0.35 s after "you can stay.": a soft two-note chip chime on F (never a startup chime)

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · the Orb's iris flicks to the monitor
beats.caption: The Orb's iris flicks to the monitor. A toast: it is catching up.

seq.place: his dark room (the home room) · the monitor

cues: the run: every item lands back on Mas and the Orb from its own angle; the rail rolls like the odometer, no slates

beats.frame: POV · the monitor: ITEM 1, the tour poster
beats.caption: The tour poster from sc 16, one more city pasted on. A caption slides under his face; a line under it.
beats.real: JUN 7-8, 2023 · asked about competing on a $10M budget: "totally hopeless to compete with us" [V · trimmed]

beats.caption: His reflection sips. The Orb's reflected iris steps down to OUT OF CONTEXT, and stays there.
ITEM 2 on the monitor: SIRRAH at a lectern, mid-answer. The A and I blocks are waist-high now.
cues: sound: the monitor down to a murmur and a laugh from her audience

beats.frame: POV · the chyron, full-bleed to read
beats.caption: The monitor's own news chyron types on under her.

onscreen.text: VP SIRRAH: "AI is kind of a fancy thing. First of all, it's two letters."

beats.real: JUL 12, 2023 · the "two letters" remark [H · printed as the chyron, not voiced]

beats.caption: Mas holds up two fingers to the Orb. The Orb, which has no fingers, whirrs, as if counting.
cues: sfx: the Orb whirrs, as if counting
music: THE COPY (MM-13) answers the hands on chip, a beat late

beats.caption: NEDIB unrolls a scroll across a desk: seven small pinky-prints, one per company.
beats.real: JUL 21, 2023 · seven companies sign voluntary commitments [P]

beats.caption: Mas raises his pinky to the screen; the Orb, with no pinky, rotates. The rail rolls past its own arrival.
A room of tiled seated figures, every one the same drawing, every hand still down. The plate asks.

onscreen.text: REMUHCS · ASKED THE ROOM: SHOULD GOVERNMENT REGULATE AI?

beats.caption: A voice from off-screen, and on it every hand in the room goes up at once: one drawing, tiled.

onscreen.text: REMUHCS · ASKED THE ROOM: SHOULD GOVERNMENT REGULATE AI?

beats.caption: Mas raises his hand too, alone at his desk; the Orb rises one pixel. NOLE's hand is highest, holding his phone.

lines.text: "It's important for us to have a referee."

beats.real: SEP 13, 2023 · "It's important for us to have a referee." [V]
cues: plate egg under the hands (zero read load): BILLS: 0

beats.caption: Mario on one phone, earnest, finger raised, mid-warning.
cues: egg in the bezel as the rail rolls (zero read): a ladder of hardcovers under one word, AUTHORS [H · SEP 19]

beats.caption: Mas, lit cyan, watching the lighthouse on the monitor past him. He sips, and says nothing.
His second phone rings. Still warning, Mario answers it. Above the lighthouse, a rent meter starts to spin.
beats.real: SEP 25, 2023 · NOZAMA commits up to $4B to MISANTHROPIC [V]
cues: sfx: the second phone rings (0.2 s); a rent meter blinks on above the lighthouse; CUT on its first tick

beats.frame: OTS · over Mas's shoulder onto the monitor (TIDDER)
beats.caption: A generic forum reply box on the parody site TIDDER. He types, in source casing.
beats.real: ~SEP 26, 2023 · the TIDDER comment [V · casing per the circulated screenshot]
cues: sfx: his keys (typed, not voiced; source casing)

beats.caption: The rack's LEDs, which have blinked in straight eighths all episode, stop. All of them. The Orb doesn't move.
cues: sound: the act's one quiet beat (< 2 s): the LEDs' tick drops out, the fans turn, the Water Line holds

beats.frame: POV · he posts: the reply counter
beats.caption: He posts. A reply counter spins, a blur; the first reply is legible, held just long enough.
cues: sfx: the counter's whirr; his phone's ring pre-laps from the desk (~1.9 s)

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · the call (held; one cut, to the edit)
beats.caption: His phone lights GERG; he thumbs it to speaker without looking away. After his answer the Orb looks at him.

lines.text: Mas, did you just post on Tidder?
Half the replies think it's a leak. The other half want to know which floor it's on.

cues: music: the Water Line thins under the call; the LEDs stay dark
sound: Gerg's keys come down the line under the whole call

beats.frame: POV · the edit (the call's one cut)
beats.caption: He clicks edit. Framed tight on the middle, the comment rewrites itself. Held to read.
beats.real: ~SEP 26, 2023 · the edit: "…just memeing, y'all have no chill…" [V]
cues: sfx: the edit click; the comment rewrites itself in place, letter by letter

beats.caption: Back on the two-shot. The LEDs resume. Two night owls on the line; the counter keeps climbing anyway.

lines.text: Okay. That's patched. Rima's going to wake up to forty emails about it.
Still running. I don't go to bed till it's green. It's bad luck.

cues: sound: the LEDs resume on the cut, relieved; the counter keeps climbing, faster, soft at frame right
sound: Gerg's keys keep going after the last line (the scene ends on Gerg and the world)

beats.frame: POV · the monitor: the rail rolls SEP -> OCT (two eggs)
beats.caption: A lightning bolt in a frame crackles in the monitor's corner; beside it, a small paper glowing.

onscreen.text: "We are the apex predator; the lightning works for us."

seq.place: his dark room (the home room) · the monitor

beats.real: OCT 16, 2023 · the manifesto: "We are the apex predator; the lightning works for us." [V] · OCT 2023 · NELEH's paper, no text [V]
cues: egg (zero read): a small paper glowing on a desk, footnote numbers orbiting it, no text; it waits for Act Four

beats.frame: POV · the signing desk (held on the monitor)
beats.caption: NEDIB, pen raised, says what the order does. Cut-paper copies pop up and add to his sentence.

lines.text: Here's the deal, folks. This order says if you build the big ones, you test them, and you show us the results.
And then the computers regulate themselves.
And no paperwork, folks. None at all.

beats.real: OCT 30, 2023 · EO 14110 signed [P] · the order's test-and-share rule, paraphrased [INVENTED wording]
cues: sfx: two pops (cut paper); the copies: scissor edges, glossier, tie a shade the wrong colour

beats.frame: POV · the signing desk: the real one turns
beats.caption: The real NEDIB turns to look at them, pen raised. His stat row updates in the corner.

lines.text: "When the hell did I say that?"

beats.real: OCT 30, 2023 · "When the hell did I say that?" [P]

beats.frame: 2S·SCR · Mas, the Orb, three NEDIBs on the monitor (slow drift in)
beats.caption: He asks the Orb. Its iris flicks across the three NEDIBs, one, two, three, and settles on the one with the pen.
cues: Mas asks his witness; the Orb's iris flicks across the three NEDIBs (0.35 / 0.75 / 1.15 s after the question) and settles on the one with the pen; then he agrees

beats.caption: The real NEDIB signs, in ink. The deepfakes clap, and keep clapping.
cues: sfx: the pen, in ink; the copies clap, and keep clapping

beats.frame: WIDE · the scroll pours out of the bezel
beats.caption: DELIVERY: the order's scroll pours out of the bezel, over the desk, across the floor, past a short one: MARIO'S MEMO.
cues: sound: the copies' clapping runs on, small, through the monitor's speaker

beats.frame: INSERT · ECU the glass on the scroll
beats.caption: Mas lifts his glass and sets it down on the scroll like a paperweight. The scroll stops.
cues: sound: the clapping carries over the cut and becomes DevDay's applause (the L-cut into sc 22)

beats.caption: On the monitor, his keynote. The odometer climbs up through the floor. TASYA walks on, laughing, arms open.

seq.place: his dark room (the home room) · the monitor

beats.real: NOV 6, 2023 · DevDay: 100,000,000 a week [V] · "We love you guys." [V] · the question is ours [INVENTED]
cues: sound: the copies' clap carried over as the crowd's applause
sfx: launch night's odometer clunks up through the stage floor (0.8 s) and settles, legible
egg in the bezel (zero read): zAI's rafters; an egg cracks; a chrome creature hatches, already muzzled

beats.frame: HIGH · the desk from above: his phone

sfx: his thumb taps [super] (~2.7 s)

the hailstone bobs in his glass, the host's glass floods the table, the ovation across the street
